title.zh: 二元一次方程组 · 两条直线的交点
title.en: Simultaneous Equations · Where Two Lines Meet

desc.zh: 一个方程有无数个解，再加一个方程就把解“钉”在两条直线的交点上；代入和加减是把它算出来的两种办法。
desc.en: One equation has endless solutions; a second equation pins the answer to where two lines cross. Substitution and elimination are two ways to calculate it.
